title: 第23章 养魂地第24章 纸扎人
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
这七只鬼在这套房里长的待了三年，短的也待了半年，都无法离开房间。
和游记上记载的养魂地描写的类似。
养尸地，养魂地情况类似，前者能够温养僵尸，后者能温养鬼。
如养鬼地，会天然的吸引鬼魂，鬼魂一旦进来就再也无法出去。
有天然的养鬼地，也有后天的养鬼地，或许是这套房的某些结构符合养鬼地，这才变成一个养鬼地，吸引了七只鬼进来。
“行了，都进那间卧室，没有我的允许，不准出来！”
顾铮一挥手，把七只鬼全部赶进一间房，然后把镇邪符贴在门上，杜绝他们出来的可能。
在有七只鬼的大平层内，顾铮安安稳稳的睡了一晚上。
一觉睡醒，顾铮正要去大批量进货，准备去大乾位面开店，王城一个电话打来：“我到小区外面了，跟保安说一声，让我进来。”
顾铮有些诧异，王城昨天都快吓成孙子了，今天居然还敢来？
不过昨天的经历，他对王城印象大好，换做唯利是图的中介巴不得他买下这套房，他最后却还是劝自己考虑一下。
不多时，王城到了门外，顾铮打开门让他进来。
他今天的样子差点闪瞎顾铮的眼睛。
外面披着一身道袍，脖子上挂着一串佛珠和一个十字架，腰间缠着一串大蒜，胸口，后背贴着几张黄纸符。
反正古今中外，各大教派驱魔的玩意在他身上都能找到。
王城站在门外小心翼翼的打量顾铮：“你……你没事吧？”
顾铮哭笑不得：“我这不好好的么？”
“你昨天见鬼了没？”
“怎么了？”
王城贼兮兮的左右瞧了瞧，慢慢挪进房中，沉声道：“我昨晚回去之后仔细回想了一下，绝不是我在做梦，你在忽悠我，这房里，真的有鬼！”

“顾铮，你听我的，把这套房卖了，前后五个房主都说这套房闹鬼，哪有这么巧的地方？”
他左右手抓着佛珠和十字架，紧张兮兮的环顾四周。
顾铮笑道：“不用了，王哥，多谢你的好意，我昨晚睡的很好。”
“真的？”
王城皱眉道，目光忽然定在了一间卧室门上的符箓：“顾铮，你既然不信，又怎么会在门上贴这玩意？”
顾铮笑而不语。
“既然如此，我也不劝了，这些东西，都送给你，或许有用。”
王城跑到门外，取下佛珠，十字架，道袍，大蒜，黄纸符……
顾铮没有拒绝他的好意，一一收下，目送他远去。
没走几步，王城忽然转头，郑重道：“顾铮，你是有对付他们的办法是吧？”
“你说呢？”
“我知道了。”
…………
批发购买香皂，香水，调味料等等比起零售价要低不少，只用了一上午时间就全部搞定了，由卖方送到他租的仓库内。
content_en:
These seven ghosts stayed in this suite for as long as three years and as short as half a year, and they were unable to leave the room.
It is similar to the description of the soul-nurturing place recorded in the travel notes.
The corpse-raising land and the soul-raising land are similar. The former can warm and raise zombies, while the latter can warm and raise ghosts.
For example, a place where ghosts are raised will naturally attract ghosts. Once the ghosts come in, they will never be able to get out.
There are natural places to raise ghosts, and there are also acquired places to raise ghosts. Perhaps some of the structure of this suite is suitable for raising ghosts, so it became a place to raise ghosts, attracting seven ghosts.
"Okay, everyone, go into that bedroom and don't come out without my permission!"
Gu Zheng waved his hand and drove all seven ghosts into a room, and then put the evil-suppressing charm on the door to prevent them from coming out.
In the flat floor where there were seven ghosts, Gu Zheng slept peacefully all night.
After waking up, Gu Zheng was about to purchase a large amount of goods and prepare to open a store in the Daqian plane. Wang Cheng received a call: "I'm outside the community. Tell the security guard to let me in."
Gu Zheng was a little surprised. Wang Cheng was almost scared to death yesterday, but he still dared to come today?
However, after yesterday's experience, he had a very good impression of Wangcheng. The profit-seeking intermediary would have liked him to buy this apartment, but he finally persuaded himself to consider it.
Not long after, Wang Cheng arrived outside the door, and Gu Zheng opened the door and let him in.
His appearance today almost blinded Gu Zheng.
He was wearing a Taoist robe, with a string of Buddhist beads and a cross hanging around his neck, a bunch of garlic wrapped around his waist, and several yellow paper charms taped to his chest and back.
Anyway, all the exorcism tools of all major sects at home and abroad can be found in him.
Wang Cheng stood outside the door and carefully looked at Gu Zheng: "You...are you okay?"
Gu Zheng didn't know whether to laugh or cry: "Isn't this good for me?"
"Did you see a ghost yesterday?"
"What's wrong?"
Wang Cheng looked around mischievously, then slowly moved into the room and said in a deep voice: "I thought about it carefully after I went back last night. I am definitely not dreaming. You are deceiving me. There is really a ghost in this room!"
"Gu Zheng, listen to me and sell this apartment. The five previous owners have said that this apartment is haunted. How can it be such a coincidence?"
He held the prayer beads and cross in his left and right hands and looked around nervously.
Gu Zheng smiled and said: "No, Brother Wang, thank you for your kindness. I slept very well last night."
"Really?"
Wang Cheng frowned and said, his eyes suddenly fixed on the talisman on the door of a bedroom: "Gu Zheng, if you don't believe it, why would you stick this thing on the door?"
Gu Zheng smiled and said nothing.
"In that case, I won't advise you anymore. I'll give these things to you. They may be useful."
Wang Cheng ran outside the door and took down the prayer beads, cross, Taoist robe, garlic, yellow paper charms...
Gu Zheng did not reject his kindness, he accepted them one by one and watched him go away.
After walking a few steps, Wang Cheng suddenly turned his head and said solemnly: "Gu Zheng, you have a way to deal with them, right?"
"What do you think?"
"I understand."
